text: Phone Study Topics is one page: title, search, type drop-down, then the question cards. The selected question opens in place to expandable sub topics, each opening to its text with Sources and Other views as further drop-downs. No separate topic page, no Open topic button.
rationale: Chris artifact comment: retain the layout with search etc from the main screen, expandable sub topics, expandable depth, drop menus where appropriate. Supersedes topics-phone-like-reference's Open topic page
